The NVIDIA RTX Spark Superchip combines NVIDIA AI, Blackwell RTX graphics, up to 20-core NVIDIA Grace CPU, and up to 128 GB of unified memory to deliver serious performance without sacrificing portability.

TAKES THE HEAT. KEEPS ITS COOL.TAKES THE HEAT. KEEPS ITS COOL.

Our largest thermal system ever keeps demanding workloads running with less fan noise. Bigger fans move more air at lower speeds, delivering up to 2.5x the thermal capacity of Surface Laptop 15-inch (8th Edition).

FORM MEETS FORCE.FORM MEETS FORCE.

Available in Platinum and new Nightfall, Surface Laptop Ultra delivers extraordinary performance in a laptop under 4.5 lbs. and under 18 mm thin. Powerful enough for demanding work, portable enough to take anywhere.

  • The world's first built-in magnetic USB-C charging port combines magnetic convenience with the versatility of a standard connection.

  • Our largest precision haptic touchpad ever gives makers a more natural way to navigate, scrub, edit, and refine.

  • Three USB-C®, USB-A, HDMI, an SD card reader, and a headphone jack. Leave the adapters and dongles behind.

Shines in any setting.Shines in any setting.

From early mornings to late nights, indoors or out, our brightest display ever adapts to wherever the work takes you.

  • THE BRIGHTEST PEAK HDR OF ANY LAPTOP

    When precision matters, every detail counts. Evaluate color, contrast, and detail with confidence on a display built for critical creative decisions.1

  • 15-inch TOUCHSCREEN DISPLAY

    Zoom, mark up, scroll, sign, and navigate directly on the display. Dolby Vision IQTM and 100% DCI-P3 color help bring creative work to life with stunning accuracy.

  • ACCELERATED RTX GAMING

    Ray-traced worlds, NVIDIA DLSS, and NVIDIA Reflex deliver stunning visuals, smooth gameplay, and ultra-responsive performance on a brilliant 120 Hz display.2

Prototype agents, review code, and test larger models while your dev tools keep running. NVIDIA CUDA™ accelerates AI workloads, including local agent workflows powered by models up to 120B parameters3.

Designed with long-term ownership in mind. Internal wayfinding, published repair guides, replacement parts, and upgradeable storage help keep your device working the way you need it for years to come4. Available SSD storage up to 2 TB gives ambitious projects room to grow.
